title: Pretty Decorative Hooks
text: Pretty Decorative Hooks. I have bought these a few times and have about 12 or more of them around my house.  I use them for hanging small decorations on my walls such as mirrors or wreaths ect.  So far they have not let me down!  They are decorative and probably only hold a couple of pounds.  I have never received silver screws or short screws with these.
